{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Re-check missing values explicitly
print('Missing values in flipper_length_mm:', df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Re-check duplicates
print('Number of duplicate rows:', df.duplicated().sum())

# Compute mean flipper length by species
grouped = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species:\n', grouped)

# Find the species with the highest mean
best_species = grouped.idxmax()
best_mean = grouped.max()

print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {best_species} ({best_mean:.2f} mm)')"}
